title: API Pagination
content:
Purpose: API Pagination.

Technical details: Cursor-based pagination uses an opaque next_cursor token. Clients must not invent cursor values. Empty pages do not necessarily mean the export is complete when a next_cursor is present.

Operational guidance: Pagination incidents should compare request parameters, cursor history, response headers, and dataset consistency.

Investigation evidence: Record affected services, timestamps, correlation identifiers, observed behavior, expected behavior, recent changes, and reproducible diagnostic steps.

Verification: Compare outcomes against documented requirements. Do not claim a root cause without supporting evidence. Document unresolved uncertainty and recommended follow-up.
